intro: The Centurion Plus is made for effortless organisation. With spacious compartments, a pull-out coat hanger, and motion-sensor lights, it delivers ease, security, and convenience.

features.title: Light up your storage automatically
features.text: Dual motion sensor lights illuminate the interior as soon as the door is opened, making it effortless to find items in any lighting condition.

features.title: Locks for added safety
features.text: The built-in locker ensures your precious belongings stay safe, giving you extra confidence in your storage solution.

features.title: Added strength for daily use
features.text: Built with high-quality CRCA steel, this almirah is designed to last through years of heavy use without compromising on strength or style.

features.title: Double drawers for better organisation
features.text: The spacious drawers provide enough room to neatly organise both small and large items, keeping your space tidy and functional.

features.title: Stylish and scratch-resistant finish
features.text: The rich finish is complemented by brass hardware, delivering timeless elegance while being durable and resistant to scratches.

features.title: Pull out hanging rod for added ease
features.text: Easily access your clothes with the convenient pull-out hanging rod, designed to simplify organisation and maximise storage efficiency within the almirah.

name: Centurion Plus 2-Door Steel Almirah With Motion Sensor Lights Bridal Blush
